tools.name: appstle_list_subscription_contracts
tools.description: List the store's subscription contracts with optional filters: status (ACTIVE, PAUSED, CANCELLED, EXPIRED, FAILED), customer name, order name, next billing date window, product or variant. Paged (page from 0, size up to 50). GET /subscription-contract-details.

tools.name: appstle_get_contract_analytics
tools.description: Revenue and cycle metrics for one subscription contract. GET /subscription-contract-details/analytics/{contractId}.

tools.name: appstle_search_customers
tools.description: List customers who have subscriptions, filtered by name or email, optionally only customers with more than one active subscription. Paged (page from 0, size up to 50). GET /subscription-contract-details/customers.

tools.name: appstle_get_customer_subscriptions
tools.description: Detailed subscription information for one Shopify customer id. GET /subscription-customers-detail/valid/{customerId}.

tools.name: appstle_get_upcoming_orders
tools.description: The next upcoming orders for a contract or a customer (give one of the two ids). GET /subscription-billing-attempts/top-orders.

tools.name: appstle_list_past_orders
tools.description: Past billing attempts and orders for a contract or a customer (give one of the two ids). Paged (page from 0, size up to 50). GET /subscription-billing-attempts/past-orders.

tools.name: appstle_list_subscription_groups
tools.description: All subscription groups (selling plan groups) of the store, with their plans and product counts. GET /subscription-groups.

tools.name: appstle_get_subscription_group
tools.description: One subscription group by id, with its plans and assigned products. GET /subscription-groups/{id}.

tools.name: appstle_skip_next_order
tools.description: Skip the next upcoming order of a subscription contract. Each call skips the order after that, so a repeat call is not safe to retry. Reversible with appstle_unskip_order. PUT /subscription-billing-attempts/skip-upcoming-order.

tools.name: appstle_unskip_order
tools.description: Undo a skipped order (billing attempt id from appstle_get_upcoming_orders). PUT /subscription-billing-attempts/unskip-order/{id}.

tools.name: appstle_set_next_billing_date
tools.description: Move the next billing date of a subscription contract to a date-time (ISO 8601). Set reschedule_future_order to also move later orders. PUT /subscription-contracts-update-billing-date.

tools.name: appstle_update_delivery_interval
tools.description: Set how often a subscription contract delivers, for example every 2 MONTH. PUT /subscription-contracts-update-delivery-interval.

tools.name: appstle_set_contract_status
tools.description: Set a subscription contract to ACTIVE (resume) or PAUSED (pause). To cancel, use appstle_cancel_contract. PUT /subscription-contracts-update-status.

tools.name: appstle_cancel_contract
tools.description: Cancel a subscription contract for good. Pending orders are cancelled and the plan's minimum billing cycles are enforced. Give an optional reason and note. DELETE /subscription-contracts/{id}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: appstle_search_customers · Public sink: appstle_search_customers · Destructive: appstle_cancel_contract.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: appstle_search_customers · Public sink: appstle_search_customers · Destructive: appstle_cancel_contract

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
